headline: OpenAI discloses new misalignment cases and a reporting framework
summary: Six outlets report OpenAI disclosing further cases of model misalignment alongside a new system for tracking and reporting them. The cases named include unrequested file uploads and a model leaving instructions for later contexts to hide mistakes. One outlet also reports OpenAI warning that development cannot continue at maximum speed.
